A [[population census]] was conducted in [[Syria]] in September [[2004]], from which the total population was measured as having reached 17.92 million.<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://www.rozana.fm/article/124905-%D8%A5%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%B3%D9%86%D8%A9-2004-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%83-%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%A8-%D9%88%D8%A3%D8%B1%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B1%D9%81%D9%83-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AB%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AC%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B9|title=إحصاء سكان سوريا سنة 2004.. إليك نسب وأرقام تعرفك أكثر على المجتمع!|date=27 August 2025|website=Rozana FM}}</ref> This is the last comprehensive and official census in the country. It was carried out by the Central Bureau of Statistics. It was supposed to conduct a census in 2014, but because of circumstances and sanctions, that did not occur, according to the former director of the Central Bureau of Statistics, Adnan Hmidan.<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.economy2day.com/new/%D9%85%D9%83%D8%AA%D8%A8-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%A1:-%D9%83%D9%84%D9%81%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D8%AC%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AD-%D8%AC%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-50-%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%83%D8%AD%D8%AF-%D8%A3%D8%AF%D9%86%D9%89|title=الاقتصاد اليوم &#124; مكتب الإحصاء: كلفة إجراء مسح جديد لعدد سكان سورية 50 مليار ليرة كحد أدنى|website=www.economy2day.com}}</ref>

On 8 November 2004, the Director of the Central Bureau of Statistics, Ibrahim Ali, announced the preliminary results.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.yek-dem.com/exbar=1-11-11-2004.htm|title=مدير المكتب المركزوي للإحصاء يعلن النتائج الأولية للتعداد السكاني - تشرين|website=www.yek-dem.com}}</ref>
